description:
Who represents a place: members of the U.S. House and Senate, state legislators and the mayor, with contacts.

    Give a geography `id` (a congressional district, state, city 'us:place:...', county, town or ZIP 'us:zcta:...')
    or a point (`lat`, `lon`; geocode an address first). For a city, county or ZIP that spans several districts, each
    representative comes with `share` = share of that area's 2020 residents in the district; for an exact answer use a
    point. Members listed are those serving now (119th Congress, until January 3, 2027); the districts are the 120th
    Congress maps elected November 3, 2026. In states that redrew for 2026 (AL, CA, FL, LA, NC, OH, TN, TX, UT) a
    representative's `note` says they were elected under the previous map. A district with no member is vacant.
    State legislators (state_legislators=True, except for a whole state, where pass it explicitly) come from Open
    States; members in states that redrew legislative maps for 2026 (MI, MN, MS) carry a similar note.
    Mayors (local=True), of cities and, where towns and townships are the local government (NJ, PA, NY, New
    England, MI, MN, WI), of those too, come from Open States (larger cities, while their term runs) or, failing that, Wikidata
    (one current head of government, in office since 2010; their `note` says to confirm on the city's website).
    Sources: the @unitedstates congress-legislators dataset (CC0), Open States (public domain), Wikidata (CC0).
    US only for now.
name: find_officials
title: Find elected officials
